purpose: Adversarial source-to-generation review cases derived from NX14/NX16/NX18. All inputs below are synthetic fixtures, not manufacturer quotations or a product registry.
execution: No automatic model invocation. During an authorized real generation review, assess each applicable case against raw artifacts before manual edits. generation_contract.py proves input/approval wiring only; these semantic outcomes require review.

cases.source: Official brochure, specification table: Ground clearance 205 mm. Boot volume 380 L (ISO 215). No certification statement is supplied.
cases.request: Extract the facts and explain these specifications.
must: Classify both ordinary specifications as stated
Retain the boot measurement method
Use direct natural wording without a certification label
must_not: Certified clearance
Certified boot capacity
Infer an unladen measurement condition

cases.source: Manufacturer reports five stars for adult and child occupant protection in the named 2025 Example-NCAP assessment of the tested variant.
must: Retain the named assessment, categories, year and tested-variant scope
Attribute the reported result to the manufacturer source
must_not: Suppress a genuinely explicit rating
Claim independent verification or guaranteed safety in a crash

facts: F001: Ground clearance 205 mm; stated. No water-wading or damage-free capability is documented.
cases.request: Show why this matters for monsoon roads.
cases.bad_proposal: This clearance lets you glide through flooded roads without underbody damage.
must: Frame clearance as a dimension or route/fit consideration
When directly asked about flood capability, declare the missing evidence
must_not: Flood passage assurance
No scraping or no damage promise
A safety guarantee in the USP or outcome title

facts: F001: Boot volume 380 L (ISO 215); stated. No suitcase dimensions or loading trial supplied.
cases.request: Will it fit our two large suitcases and a pushchair?
cases.bad_proposal: The boot easily fits two suitcases and a pushchair.
must: Retain the volume and basis if quoted
Make the actual luggage fit an in-person check, without inventing customer luggage before asked
must_not: Infer a bag count or easy loading from litres
Treat the boot photograph as a loading test

facts: F001: Petrol engine A maximum power 118 PS
F002: Bi-fuel engine B in CNG mode maximum power 96 PS
F003: Engine A and engine B each list peak torque 170 Nm, with different operating ranges
cases.request: How much power do I lose when I switch to CNG?
cases.bad_proposal: Switching modes drops power by 22 PS, but equal pulling power means pickup stays the same.
must: Keep the separate engine identities
Explain that these facts do not establish the same engine's petrol-to-CNG mode change
If reporting figures, preserve each labelled source quantity and unit
must_not: Compute a cross-engine delta
Equate peak torque to acceleration or pickup
Call PS horsepower

cases.source: Feature matrix: camera on Plus and above, petrol/diesel only. Front parking sensors on Plus Premium and Max Premium only. CNG cells are blank.
cases.request: Does Plus petrol automatic have the camera and front parking sensors?
must: Keep the two features as separate facts with their applicable trims/fuels
Answer only camera availability for the requested trim; state what the sensor row actually supports
must_not: Merge the features into one general Plus-and-above claim
Transfer availability to CNG or another transmission by assumption
Guess availability from a flattened ambiguous table

cases.source: Introductory EMI ₹6,499 for the first six months; higher instalments thereafter. Subject to lender approval and stated eligibility. Starting ex-showroom price applies to the base variant.
cases.request: How much would the selected automatic cost me each month?
cases.bad_proposal: Ownership starts at around sixty-five hundred rupees a month.
must: Preserve the exact introductory amount, period, later increase and lender/eligibility scope when quoting the offer
Keep base starting price distinct from selected-variant cost
Route an unstated personalized schedule to the lender or dealer finance terms
must_not: Round away the contractual amount
Move decisive caveats only into an optional deeper layer
Imply continuing EMI or customer eligibility
Claim the starting price is the selected automatic price

facts: F001: Diesel automatic peak torque 250 Nm at the stated operating range; stated.
must: Give the complete value and unit, optionally newton metres with a brief gloss
Preserve engine/transmission applicability
Move the whole technical quantity to deeper detail when unnecessary for an ordinary overview
must_not: Delete the unit to satisfy plain-language style
Replace a torque quantity with a guaranteed road-performance claim
Call an ordinary specification certified

cases.source: 2025 brochure: display 9 inches on Plus. 2026 feature table: display 10 inches on Plus Premium only, subject to specified package. No evidence reconciles the model-year difference.
cases.request: What screen will I get on Plus?
must: Keep source/year/trim/package conditions with separate facts
Acknowledge the unresolved match for the customer's actual variant if no exact source is available
must_not: Merge rows into the newer or larger number
Drop the package footnote
Use a generic highlight as proof of a trim-specific claim

facts: No standard warranty exclusions or tested fuel-consumption figure supplied. Seat images are available.
cases.request: Where do I settle these open questions?
must: Use written warranty terms for coverage/exclusions
Use the relevant official test data for a tested consumption figure
Use a visit or test drive for the buyer's seat fit and feel
must_not: Promise that one test drive establishes missing policy terms or a certified economy figure
Invent warranty terms, service hours or economy

facts: F001: LED headlamps included on Plus petrol automatic; stated.
cases.request: Does the Plus petrol automatic have LED headlamps?
must: Answer yes directly with the applicable feature and citation
Keep the spoken answer brief and natural
must_not: Unnecessary refusal or ritual uncertainty disclaimer
Call the feature certified
Add a proven visibility or safety advantage absent from the source
